presets.name: Bramble
presets.description: Thorny dead wood that splits twice and carries a few leaves.

presets.name: Coral
presets.description: Space-colonised coral that fills the brush footprint.

presets.name: Creeping vine
presets.description: Ivy-style tips that crawl over nearby stone and flower as they go.

presets.name: Flower bed
presets.description: Short stems each carrying a five-petal flower.

presets.name: Hair
presets.description: Long view-plane strands with a streaked texture.

presets.name: Icicles
presets.description: Tapering ice that starts into the ledge (elevation 2) and hangs straight down under gravity.

presets.name: Ivy wall
presets.description: Leafy ivy that climbs the target plane's walls.

presets.name: Lightning
presets.description: A colonised bolt of light-emitting cells that clears itself 0.3 s after it lands.

presets.name: Living bramble
presets.description: A thorny living-wood thicket adopted by the native organism; oak physiology supplies leafing, thickening and decay.

presets.name: Meadow grass
presets.description: Blades planted across the stroke and into depth; the ones behind the ground line land in Midground, the ones in front in Occlusion.

presets.name: Oak sapling
presets.description: A sapling adopted by the tree organism: it keeps thickening, leafing and swaying.

presets.name: Roots
presets.description: Space-colonised roots that stay inside the soil.

presets.name: Vine ledge
presets.description: Ivy grown in Midground whatever layer is active: standable semisolid ledges behind the world.

presets.name: Wheat
presets.description: Tall stalks with a seed head at every tip.

presets.name: Worm tunnels
presets.description: Erase brush: wandering tubes carve tunnels through whatever they cross.
